chunks: Men were once a community of one faith; but they differed (and followed different ways). Had it not been for the word proclaimed by your Lord before, their differences would have been resolved.

key_terms.فِيمَا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ: in that over which they differ

ai.seo_question: Why did humanity differ in religion according to Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind the postponement of the final judgment, allowing humanity the period of *Tahaddi* (trial) to exercise free will amidst their divergence from the original monotheistic unity. It underscores that the current multiplicity of beliefs is not a flaw in creation but a necessary condition for the test of faith, resolved only by God's pre-eternal decree. This perspective emphasizes that ultimate justice is deferred to ensure a fair assessment of human choices rather than immediate retribution.
